env._comment_profile: FIX: was '--profile all' (loads dba_*/qlty_*/fs_*/sec_*/ML/plot/BAR tools alongside base_*, which confused Qwen2.5's tool selection -- see mcp_profiles/profiles.yml for the full story). Now loads the custom 'banking' profile, which exposes ONLY base_* and tdvs_* tools. graph/agent.py injects CONFIG_DIR below with the absolute path to mcp_profiles/ at launch time -- do not hardcode a relative path here, it won't resolve correctly if the server is spawned with a different working directory.
env._comment_disclosure: Second line of defense on top of the narrowed profile: even a handful of tools is safer behind progressive disclosure, which exposes only 2 proxy tools (search_tool, execute_tool) to the LLM instead of listing every tool up front -- the LLM searches by keyword before calling anything.
